document.title: Kimi K2.7 Code (Hugging Face model card)

summary: Moonshot AI's Hugging Face README for Kimi K2.7 Code describes a coding-focused agentic model built on Kimi K2.6 with a 1T-parameter MoE architecture and 256K context. The card provides capability benchmarks, deployment and usage guidance, and license information, but it contains little safety-evaluation content and the model is retired in the GitHub catalog.

capabilities.text: Coding-focused agentic model built on Kimi K2.6 for long-horizon software tasks.
MoE architecture with 1T total parameters, 32B activated parameters, 61 layers, 384 experts, 8 selected experts per token, and 256K context.
MoonViT-based vision support is listed in the architecture table and examples show image/video calls.
Official usage examples run in thinking mode and support preserve-thinking behavior for multi-turn coding-agent work.

evaluations.context: Coding benchmark with Kimi K2.6, GPT-5.5, and Claude Opus 4.8 comparators

safety_findings.text: No dedicated safety-evaluation section is present; the published table focuses on capabilities.
Deployment guidance specifies supported engines and version constraints, which aids reproducible serving but does not measure safety.
Usage notes identify experimental video support and lack of instant mode, which are operational cautions rather than behavioral guarantees.
The license section states the code and weights are under a Modified MIT License, without an accompanying safety policy in the card.

limitations.text: The README does not report training data, training dates, or a full technical-report lineage for K2.7 Code.
Comparisons use different agent products and effort settings across Kimi, GPT, and Claude entries.
No harmful-content, cyber, jailbreak, or prompt-injection robustness scores are reported.
Video input is experimental outside the official API, instant mode is unsupported, and preserve-thinking is always on.
The GitHub catalog marks the model retired as of 2026-10-02.

practical_implications.text: GitHub retired the model on 2026-10-02; remaining guidance is for historical comparison and lineage understanding.
Use the card to understand coding-agent positioning, not broad safety behavior.
Run tests and code review for generated changes, especially in long multi-step tasks.
Do not import claims from other Kimi reports unless this README repeats them.
Treat multimodal and third-party deployment details as constrained by the README's usage notes.

coverage_notes: This digest uses the Hugging Face Markdown model card only, covering its introduction, summary table, evaluation table, footnotes, deployment section, model-usage section, and license. It does not substitute older or newer Kimi technical reports for this retired model.
